> Hi Julie — thanks for flagging this. I'm looking into it now. I see the account created this morning from IPs that match a small cluster we flagged for rotating disposable domains last week.

Quick analysis: I pulled the session logs (attached). Observations:
- Five signups in a 22-minute window from domains that resolve to the same mail-forwarding provider (pattern: *.maildrop.xyz).
- Two accounts used the same browser fingerprint + same device cookie ID (probable scripted flow).
- Token consumption pattern is textbook automated probing: 30 short generation calls in <3 minutes, then long idle.

Recommendation: hold full credit issuance. Offer a limited manual credit (1,000 tokens) for verification and request a company phone or corporate domain verification. If they provide a verifiable corporate billing contact, we can escalate to full issuance.

If Sales wants to treat as a legitimate inbound, I can whitelist the HubSpot company id for one-time credits but mark for stricter rate limits and monitoring.
